test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A sustained decline in Chinese consumption would be even more ______ than the current US-China trade dispute.
solution:
The correct answer is-'worrying'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option:
 
 
• worrying: *making you feel unhappy and frightened*
 
• Imagining: to form a picture or idea in your mind of what something/somebody might be lik
 
• delaying: to make somebody/something slow or late
 
• mobilising: to organize people or things to do something
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is 'worrying'.
 
• Thus, *option 1 *is the correct answer.

 

The correct sentence is:* **A sustained decline in Chinese consumption would be even more **worrying*__* than the current US-China trade dispute.*
